title: Iaijutsu - Bukijutsu Sword Style
body:
Syntax: SWORDSTYLE Iaijutsu | SWORDSTYLE LIST | SWORDSTYLE OFF

Iaijutsu unlocks for Bukijutsu at level 85 and is learned automatically at that level. A fast draw-and-cut school emphasizing an accurate opening. Wield one sword to use it.

At 100% mastery: +8 accuracy and +8% sword damage. Each landed strike costs 2 Stamina. Bonuses increase with mastery, starting at a partial strength. Use PRAC <school name> with a teacher for your initial lesson and improve it by landing ordinary sword attacks while selected. Only one sword school may be active at a time; its selection persists across logins. See HELP SWORDSTYLE for the full list.
